exports.source:
la $s0, values
    la $t0, count
    lw $s1, 0($t0)
    la $t0, algorithm
    lw $s7, 0($t0)
    move $s6, $zero
    la $t0, swap_count
    sw $zero, 0($t0)
    la $t0, phase
    sw $zero, 0($t0)
    move $a0, $s0
    move $a1, $s1
    jal render
    nop

west_wait:
    lw $t2, 0x30($s0)
    bne $t2, $zero, west_wait
    nop
    sw $zero, 0x50($s0)
west_stopped:

la $a0, signed_msg
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
    move $a0, $s0
    li $v0, 1
    syscall
    la $a0, newline
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
signed_printed:

move $t3, $zero
    lbu $t1, -11($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, -10($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, -9($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, -1($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, 1($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, 9($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, 10($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, 11($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
neighbors_counted:
# mars:tool bitmap width=64 height=64 unitWidth=32 unitHeight=32 base=static_data

li $t0, 2
    la $t1, phase
    sw $t0, 0($t1)
    move $a0, $s0
    move $a1, $s1
    jal render
    nop

move $s2, $zero
selection_outer:
    addiu $t0, $s1, -1
    slt $t0, $s2, $t0
    beq $t0, $zero, sort_end
    nop
    move $s4, $s2
    addiu $s3, $s2, 1

south_wait:
    lw $t2, 0x40($s0)
    bne $t2, $s1, south_wait
    nop
    sw $zero, 0x50($s0)
south_stopped:

xori $t4, $t3, 3
    sltiu $t4, $t4, 1
    xori $t5, $t3, 2
    sltiu $t5, $t5, 1
    lbu $t6, 0($s7)
    and $t5, $t5, $t6
    or $t4, $t4, $t5
rule_decided:

move $t3, $zero
    slt $t4, $t2, $a1
    beq $t4, $zero, render_store
    nop
    sll $t4, $t2, 2
    daddu $t4, $a0, $t4
    lw $t5, 0($t4)
    addiu $t5, $t5, 5
    li $t6, 8
    subu $t5, $t6, $t5
    slt $t6, $t1, $t5
    bne $t6, $zero, render_store
    nop
    li $t3, 0x00ffffff
render_store:
    sw $t3, 0($t0)
    daddiu $t0, $t0, 4

north_wait:
    lw $t2, 0x40($s0)
    bne $t2, $zero, north_wait
    nop
    sw $zero, 0x50($s0)
north_stopped:

slt $t1, $s2, $s0
    bne $t1, $zero, swap_endpoints
    nop
    bne $s0, $s2, ordered
    nop
    slt $t1, $s3, $s1
    beq $t1, $zero, ordered
    nop
swap_endpoints:
    move $t1, $s0
    move $s0, $s2
    move $s2, $t1
    move $t1, $s1
    move $s1, $s3
    move $s3, $t1
ordered:

li $s4, 1
cell_row:
    li $s5, 1
cell_loop:
    sll $t0, $s4, 3
    sll $t1, $s4, 1
    addu $t0, $t0, $t1
    addu $t0, $t0, $s5
    daddu $s7, $s0, $t0
    daddu $t7, $s1, $t0

beq $s3, $zero, insertion_next
    nop
    sll $t0, $s3, 2
    daddu $t0, $s0, $t0
    lw $t1, -4($t0)
    lw $t2, 0($t0)
    slt $t3, $t2, $t1
    beq $t3, $zero, insertion_next
    nop

beq $s4, $s2, selection_next
    nop
    sll $t0, $s2, 2
    daddu $t0, $s0, $t0
    lw $t1, 0($t0)
    sll $t2, $s4, 2
    daddu $t2, $s0, $t2
    lw $t3, 0($t2)
    sw $t3, 0($t0)
    sw $t1, 0($t2)
selection_swapped:
    addiu $s6, $s6, 1
    la $t0, swap_count
    sw $s6, 0($t0)
    li $t0, 1
    la $t1, phase
    sw $t0, 0($t1)
    move $a0, $s0
    move $a1, $s1
    jal render
    nop

addiu $t2, $t2, 1
    slti $t4, $t2, 8
    bne $t4, $zero, render_cell
    nop
    addiu $t1, $t1, 1
    slti $t4, $t1, 8
    bne $t4, $zero, render_row
    nop

addiu $s5, $s5, 1
    slti $t0, $s5, 9
    bne $t0, $zero, cell_loop
    nop
    addiu $s4, $s4, 1
    slti $t0, $s4, 9
    bne $t0, $zero, cell_row
    nop
generation_computed:

li $t6, 0
    and $t5, $t8, $t4
    beq $t5, $zero, write_mirror
    nop
    li $t6, 0x00ffffff
write_mirror:
    sw $t6, 0($t7)
pair_written:

la $a0, unsigned_msg
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
    move $a0, $s0
    li $v0, 36
    syscall
    la $a0, newline
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
unsigned_printed:

la $t0, frame
    move $t1, $zero
render_row:
    move $t2, $zero
render_cell:

slt $t0, $s3, $s1
    beq $t0, $zero, selection_exchange
    nop
    sll $t0, $s4, 2
    daddu $t0, $s0, $t0
    lw $t1, 0($t0)
    sll $t2, $s3, 2
    daddu $t2, $s0, $t2
    lw $t3, 0($t2)
    slt $t4, $t3, $t1
    beq $t4, $zero, selection_keep
    nop
    move $s4, $s3
selection_keep:
    addiu $s3, $s3, 1
    beq $zero, $zero, selection_scan
    nop

la $t0, sprite
    la $t1, sprite_end
    la $s0, frame
    la $s1, mirrored_rows

prompt:  .asciiz "Enter a small integer: "
answer:  .asciiz "Twice your number plus one is: "
newline: .asciiz "\n"

lbu $t4, 0($t0)
    subu $t4, $zero, $t4
    and $t4, $t4, $t5
    sw $t4, 0($t1)
    daddiu $t0, $t0, 1
    daddiu $t1, $t1, 4

addiu $t3, $t3, -1
    bne $t3, $zero, seed_cell
    nop
    daddiu $t1, $t1, 2
    addiu $t2, $t2, -1
    bne $t2, $zero, seed_row
    nop
seed_copied:

li $s6, 1
    bgez $s5, absolute_ready
    nop
    subu $s5, $zero, $s5
    li $s6, -1
absolute_ready:

sw $t2, -4($t0)
    sw $t1, 0($t0)
insertion_swapped:
    addiu $s3, $s3, -1
    addiu $s6, $s6, 1
    la $t0, swap_count
    sw $s6, 0($t0)
    li $t0, 1
    la $t1, phase
    sw $t0, 0($t1)
    move $a0, $s0
    move $a1, $s1
    jal render
    nop
    beq $zero, $zero, insertion_inner
    nop

east_wait:
    lw $t2, 0x30($s0)
    bne $t2, $s1, east_wait
    nop
east_stop:
    sw $zero, 0x50($s0)
east_stopped:

bne $s0, $s2, advance
    nop
    beq $s1, $s3, done
    nop
advance:

beq $s7, $zero, insertion_sort
    nop
    beq $zero, $zero, selection_sort
    nop

slt $t3, $t2, $s5
    bne $t3, $zero, skip_x
    nop
    addu $s7, $s7, $s5
    addiu $s0, $s0, 1
skip_x:

addiu $t3, $t3, -1
    bne $t3, $zero, render_cell
    nop
    daddiu $t0, $t0, 2
    addiu $t2, $t2, -1
    bne $t2, $zero, render_row
    nop
    la $t0, generation
    sw $s3, 0($t0)
generation_ready:

column_loop:
    li $t6, 0
    and $t5, $t3, $t4
    beq $t5, $zero, write_normal
    nop
    li $t6, 0x00ffffff
write_normal:
    sw $t6, 0($t2)

la $t8, frame
    la $t0, color
    lw $t9, 0($t0)
line_loop:

la $a0, hex_msg
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
    move $a0, $s0
    li $v0, 34
    syscall
    la $a0, newline
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
hex_printed:

slt $t3, $s4, $t2
    bne $t3, $zero, skip_y
    nop
    addu $s7, $s7, $s4
    addu $s1, $s1, $s6
skip_y:

la $a0, binary_msg
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
    move $a0, $s0
    li $v0, 35
    syscall
    la $a0, newline
    li $v0, 4
    syscall

li $s2, 1
insertion_outer:
    slt $t0, $s2, $s1
    beq $t0, $zero, sort_end
    nop
    move $s3, $s2

la $t0, endpoints
    lw $s0, 0($t0)
    lw $s1, 4($t0)
    lw $s2, 8($t0)
    lw $s3, 12($t0)
inputs_loaded:

la $s0, board_a
    la $s1, board_b
    la $t0, generations
    lw $s2, 0($t0)
    move $s3, $zero

la $t0, seed
    daddiu $t1, $s0, 11
    li $t2, 8
seed_row:
    li $t3, 8
seed_cell:

render:
    daddiu $t0, $s0, 11
    la $t1, frame
    li $t2, 8
    li $t5, 0x00ffffff
render_row:
    li $t3, 8
render_cell:
